summary: Iteration 12 — Frontend-only verification of SoundMap REDESIGN Phase 3 Perform Hub at /perform. All 6 review scenarios pass with 100% success (15/15 assertions PASS). (1) AI Home → click objective-live → navigates to /perform; perform-hub-title renders correctly. (2) Kiosk CTA: perform-goto-kiosk visible with href=/kiosk; click navigates to /kiosk and kiosk-root is visible. (3) SPL Meter integrated: perform-spl-meter-wrap present, wrapping SPLMeter component with spl-toggle-btn ('Iniciar'), spl-value ('—' idle), spl-calibrate-btn all visible. Did NOT click Iniciar (mic denied in headless per brief). (4) Quick actions row: perform-quick-actions container renders both cards — perform-goto-export (href=/export-page, text 'Generar reporte técnico' ✓) and perform-goto-dsp (href=/design when no DSP; href=/dsp when demo/DSP loaded ✓). (5) Empty state: after clearing localStorage/IndexedDB and navigating to /perform, perform-hub-title == 'Sin recinto activo', description contains 'Cargá al menos un top o un sub para poder ejecutar la performance', perform-goto-design visible with text 'Volver al diseño' href=/design. (6) Regression: loadDemoVenue via /design → design-step-room-quick then goto /perform → title becomes 'The Warehouse Club', perform-goto-dsp switches to /dsp (hasDsp=true), perform-goto-design correctly hidden when hasSystem. Command palette (⌘K / Ctrl+K) opens overlay from / and closes with Escape. /settings replay-tour-btn intact — legacy routes preserved. Zero pageerrors. Zero console errors. Cloudflare 429 mitigation (≥6s spacing) held throughout.
critical_code_review_comments: src/pages/perform-hub/index.tsx L16: `target` state is initialised to undefined and never setter'd — the `useState<number|undefined>` is effectively a dead-branch. Either wire it to a store selector (settings.splTarget) or drop the state and pass `target={undefined}` (or omit) directly. Currently the SPLMeter target-row always renders `—` even for users with a saved target.

src/pages/perform-hub/index.tsx L18: `hasSystem` gates the description subcopy but NOT the SPLMeter/Kiosk/QuickActions render — those still show on empty state. This is arguably correct (user can still explore), but the copy 'Cargá al menos un top o un sub para poder ejecutar la performance' feels contradicted by an active-looking SPL card underneath. Consider dimming or disabling the SPL block on empty state, or moving perform-goto-design higher (currently only appears at the very bottom of the page).

src/pages/perform-hub/index.tsx L148: `dspUnits[0].model` is accessed without a null-guard inside the ternary. Since the branch is only reached when `hasDsp` is true (dspUnits.length > 0), it's safe, but a nullish-check + fallback string would harden it against future refactors that separate `dspUnits` count from array truthiness.

src/pages/perform-hub/index.tsx L120-121: `to={hasDsp ? '/dsp' : '/design'}` — the destination diverges silently based on state. On empty state the DSP card title says 'Configurar DSP' → /design (works, but the user lands on the Design Hub, not on a DSP config screen). Consider linking to `/dsp` in both cases (empty state can render a DSP-empty CTA there) for consistency with the card's label.

src/pages/perform-hub/index.tsx L52,100,127: inline `boxShadow` and `background` styles repeat the same rgba tokens as the Design Hub cards. Consider extracting a shared `<HubCard>` component (or a Tailwind class utility) — cuts ~30 lines of duplication and centralises the v5 shell look.

Design Hub / Perform Hub parallel-symmetry note: DesignHub uses `design-hub-goto-perform` (only at 6/6), and PerformHub uses `perform-goto-design` (only when !hasSystem). This is a nice minimal 'return arrow' pattern — no bug, just a positive observation.
